_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for lotto-board. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Four sub-components share one prefix: NumberSearchBox (cell-*, row-*), MenuButton (menu-*), SetSelect (set-*), SearchCard (card-*).

base._source-cell-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 53x64 is the fixed frame size of a digit box in number-search-box-2, and neither 53 nor 64 has a semantic sizing scale to sit on (design.md has no `sizing` group)
base._source-menu-item-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 114x44 is the fixed frame size of a menu-button item. 44 equals primitive.a11y.touch-target-min-px, but a11y lives at the primitive tier and refs may only point at {design.semantic.*}, so it stays a literal
base._source-set-image-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 72x69 is the fixed frame size of the lottery-card thumbnail in set-select
base._source-set-stepper-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 48x48 is the fixed frame size of the minus/plus buttons in set-select
base._source-set-quantity-min-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — reserves room for the widest Thai quantity label so the stepper does not reflow as the number grows
base._source-set-icon-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md's semantic.iconography.sizes are still 'tbd'; Figma binds the icons-size component at Size=24
base._source-card-max-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — the search-card frame is 400 wide in Figma and design.md's breakpoints start at 321/361/390, none of which is 400
base._source-typography-caption: the old tokens.ts comment named this role `caption` (12/18 Medium), but semantic.typography.caption.md.regular is 10/16 regular and caption.lg.regular is 12/18 *regular*. The role that matches the rendered 12px/18px/500 byte-for-byte is label.md.medium, so that is what it refs.
base._source-typography-number: storybook-local, no Figma token backs the size/line-height/weight — the digit style is 24px/32px Bold, and no semantic typography role resolves to that on mobile (size.xl is 20/24, size.2xl is 28/32) and no role carries weight.bold at all. Only family and tracking, which every role shares, are refs.

_source.randomize-*: The randomise control is Figma's `button-special`: 114x54, radius 8, filled with a linear gradient from #262626 at 0% to #E32321 at 66%, label `colors/button/accent/btn-fg-bg-white` (#FEF2F2), 24px glyph. Neither the gradient nor #FEF2F2 exists as a semantic token, so both stand verbatim.
_source.randomize-gap: 4, from `Frame 1000012333` inside `button-special` — a HORIZONTAL row holding the 24px glyph then the label. Read on 2026-08-20.
_source.typography-number: The digits in the number cells carry the text style `typography/display/xl-semb` — 20/36 Semibold, read off lotto-board-mobile (14583:89931) on 2026-08-21, and the style id is set on the layer, so this is Figma's own naming rather than a guess. The overlay used to say 24/32 weight 700, which matched no layer and no role: an invented value that survived because nothing forced typography to bind.

_verified_from.scope: variant lists for all four sets, depth-3 walks, plus a rendered screenshot of lotto-board-mobile
_verified_from.result: Cell 53x64 with 8 padding, radius 8, a 1px `lotto-board-border` stroke and elevation.card; cell gap 8; row padding 16. Menu row 390x44 with three 114x44 buttons, gap 8, radius 8. Search row: a 114x54 randomise button and a 236x54 search button, gap 8. All geometry matches.

corrections.header layout: Figma lays the title and the draw date side by side on one 24px row with an 8px gap, and puts `ล้างค่า` at the far end. The library stacked the title above the date.
corrections.date colour: `Color/Text/Text-Secondary` (#262626) — the same weight as body copy, not a dimmed grey.
corrections.randomise button: Was `Button variant=outline`, a white pill. Figma fills it with a dark-to-red gradient and sets the label to #FEF2F2.

_figma_gaps.button-special-not-a-button-variant: Figma models the randomise control as its own component set, `button-special` (14291:131519, 12 variants), rather than a variant of `button`. The library renders its shape inside LottoBoard. Whether it should become a Button variant is a designer's call.
_figma_gaps.search-card-is-a-second-set: `search-card` (19002:25158) repeats lotto-board-mobile with a different title and a root gap of 8 instead of 16. Two sets for one thing.
_figma_gaps.randomise-glow: Figma layers two blurred #262626 ellipses over the gradient (LAYER_BLUR 16) for a glow. The library renders the gradient alone — close, but not the same thing. Recorded rather than approximated.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-AI: the randomise tile, `Search > button-special > Button > Frame 1000012333`, a 24px glyph before สุ่มตัวเลข. The overlay used to record that this glyph did not exist in the set; it did.
icons.filled-add: the stepper's increment, same row. Was outline-add.
icons.filled-minus: the stepper's decrement, `set-select > Frame 1000012300 > Frame 44720 > Button`. Was outline-minus.
